name: Cash Entry 2
definition: Posting of an item to a cash account, in the context of a cash transaction, that results in an increase or decrease to the balance of the account.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money in the cash entry.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Date at which an entry is posted to an account on the account servicer's books.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of an entry on the books of the account servicer.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an entry, as assigned by the account servicer.

StatementIdentification.name: Statement Identification
StatementIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the account servicer, to unambiguously identify the account statement.

AccountServicerReference.name: Account Servicer Reference
AccountServicerReference.definition: Sequential number of the statement, as assigned by the account servicer.|Usage: The sequential number is increased incrementally for each statement sent electronically.
